args: updown list -r -
stdin: ref.fasta
exit: 1
--- stderr
Error: only one input can be read from stdin, but --query and --root are both stdin
Usage:
  gofasta updown list [flags]

Flags:
  -q, --query string     Alignment of sequences to parse, in fasta format (default "stdin")
  -r, --root string      Root sequence, in fasta format, which is treated as the ancestor in the imaginary tree (required)
  -o, --outfile string   Where to write the list, in CSV format (default "stdout")
      --strict           Stop with an error at the first record that can't be processed, instead of warning and skipping it
  -t, --threads int      Number of threads (and CPUs) to use (with no flag, all CPUs are used)
  -h, --help             help for list
